Container.Name: note-taker
Container.Overview: Block-based note-taking (Notion-style pages, nested pages, trash) in the browser. Stores notes in SQLite under /data by default, or in PostgreSQL/MariaDB via DATABASE_URL. The first visitor creates the first account; registration is closed after that. Put it behind your HTTPS reverse proxy before exposing it outside your network.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: HTTP port of the web app and API.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database (when DATABASE_URL is empty). Back this folder up.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: Optional. postgres://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:5432/DB or mariadb://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:3306/DB. Empty = SQLite in /data. The database must exist; tables are created automatically.

Config.Name: REGISTRATION
Config.Description: closed: only the first-run account. open: anyone who can reach the server can sign up.

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Keep true when served over HTTPS (reverse proxy). Set false only to try it over plain HTTP on your LAN.
